Checks.Name: Journal header is durably created without a game or IWAD
First append-only command batch is accepted
Torn final line is discarded while complete batches survive
Recovery preserves every consumed command in order
Recovery preserves sparse automap input and ordered menu controls
Checkpoint replacement at the same tic keeps the newest state
Recovered output validates as the existing version-4 replay format
Recovered replay retains controls, checkpoints and campaign continuation
Recovery marks the artifact as a partial journal prefix
Recovery CLI emits journal and replay hashes with the recovered tic count
Recovery rejects out-of-batch ControlEvents tic 2
Recovery rejects out-of-batch Checkpoints tic 2
Recovery rejects out-of-batch Transitions tic 2
Recovery rejects out-of-batch Transitions tic 6
Recovery never overwrites an existing replay
Complete journal record tampering is rejected by its checksum
Worker accepts the journal path and source identity
Worker writes the initial state before accepting commands
Worker flushes periodic and transition checkpoints
Worker flushes remaining commands during shutdown
Host passes a fresh companion journal path to the worker
Host removes the journal only after a replay is written

Meaning: Offline contract and static wiring checks for append-only input-replay journaling and recovery. Uses synthetic command data and temporary files only; launches no game, user process, display, or audio device.
